description: Submit a vendor invoice for review, as a requester. Validates the fields, writes the invoice row (a new one, or the returned one at revision + 1 when invoice_id is given), appends the submitted or resubmitted event, then reviews the invoice in the same run: the deterministic checks in code, the policy judgment in the invoice-reviewer subagent. Returns { invoice_id, revision, recommendation, review_id }. Fired only from the requester's Submit form via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools.

invoice_id.description: Present on a resubmission: the returned invoice to replace.

po_number.description: The purchase order the invoice bills against, or omitted.

total_usd.description: The total the vendor states. Not forced to equal the line sum.
